source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Ensure you have permits and regulatory guidelines.
3. Identify type and source of pollutants.
4. Conduct continuous emissions monitoring (CEM).
5. Measure concentrations of pollutants.
6. Compare with regulatory limits.
7. Record frequency and duration of excess emissions.
8. Report on meteorological conditions during excess emissions.
9. Conduct stack testing if necessary.
10. Document crew actions and mitigations during excessive emissions.
11. Provide data in tables, graphs, and charts.
12. Include non-compliance events and notifications.
13. Describe any equipment malfunctions or issues.
14. Analyze trends and patterns of excessive emissions.
15. Offer recommendations for emission reduction strategies.
16. Verify all data with quality assurance checks.
17. Submit preliminary findings to regulatory authorities.
18. Include an executive summary.
19. Provide an analysis of health and environmental impacts.
20. Review and finalize the air-quality report.

Tips and Notes:
- Be thorough and consistent in your
